study type: Retrospective observational study with time-series analysis
exposure: Implementation of infection control and prevention measures
outcome: In-hospital mortality rates for MR and non-MR LONS
cohort: Newborns diagnosed with late-onset neonatal sepsis (LONS) and positive cultures for Staphylococcus aureus, Gram-negative bacteria (GNB), and Enterococcus sp in a Brazilian level III neonatal unit from 2000 to 2020.
finding: The overall late-onset neonatal sepsis (LONS) rate significantly declined from 2000 to 2016, and multidrug-resistant (MR) sepsis prevalence remained low and stable without increasing in-hospital mortality.
